DETAILS OF WORK Sr. No. Description Details 1 Name of Work Installation of RO Water Filter in Zilla Parishad School @ various place 4 Place Capacity 25 LPH 2 Estimated Amount Rs. 1,92,000/- 3 Work Location Zilla Parishad School Various place at save

4 District Solapur, Maharashtra 5 Nature of Work Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of RO system 25 LPH 4 NOS 6 Completion Period Within 60 days from the date of work order 7 Last Date for Submission xxx/ 11 / 2026 8 Date of Opening xxx/ 11 / 2026 2. SPECIAL ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS 1. The bidder/contractor must be based in Solapur District, Maharashtra, and must have an office or servic e facility within Solapur District. 2. Since the work involves service and maintenance, the contractor must be capable of providing prompt a fter-sales service at the school site. 3. Physical inspection of the school premises before submission of the tender is compulsory. 4. After inspection, the contractor must obtain the prescribed Site Inspection Report duly signed by the Sar panch or Gramsevak of the concerned village. 5. The inspection report must record the water source, inlet water TDS, proposed RO installation location, pipeline distances, electrical supply, drainage arrangements and all materials required to make the RO system full y operational. 6. The duly signed Site Inspection Report must be attached to the tender. Tenders submitted without this r eport may be treated as incomplete. 7. The contractor shall include in the quoted amount all materials, fittings, pipeline, wiring, transportation, labour, installation and commissioning expenses required for a complete working system. 3. GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The tender shall be submitted in the prescribed manner, duly filled in and signed, along with all required supporting documents. 2. The quoted rate shall clearly state whether GST and all applicable taxes are included. Transportation, la bour, installation, testing, fittings and commissioning charges shall be included in the quoted amount. 3. All equipment and components supplied shall be new, genuine, of good quality and suitable for the inten ded use. ZP School RO Water Filter Tender Notice 4. The RO system capacity and technical specifications shall be suitable for the school's requirements and the

quality of the available raw water. 5. The contractor shall provide all components required for proper operation, including suitable pre-filters, sediment filter, activated carbon filter, RO membrane, pumps, post-filter, storage tank, valves, connectors and nece ssary accessories, as applicable. 6. The contractor shall arrange and complete all required pipeline work, plumbing, electrical connections, drainage connections and fittings necessary to make the system fully operational. 7. After installation, the contractor shall test the complete system and record inlet and treated-water outle t TDS readings. The test report shall be handed over to the concerned authority/school. 8. The contractor shall explain the operation and routine maintenance of the system to the concerned scho ol staff. 9. The contractor shall provide a minimum warranty of ______ months for the supplied system and workma nship. Warranty terms shall be clearly mentioned in the quotation. 10. Any defect arising from defective material or workmanship during the warranty period shall be rectifie d by the contractor at no additional cost, subject to the stated warranty terms. 11. The work shall be completed within the stipulated period and to the satisfaction of the competent auth ority. 12. Payment shall be made only after satisfactory completion, testing, submission of required documents and certification by the competent authority, as per applicable rules. 13. The competent authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all tenders, or cancel the tender p rocess, in accordance with applicable rules. 14. Any misrepresentation, submission of false documents or failure to comply with tender conditions may result in rejection of the tender. 15. All applicable government procurement rules, safety requirements and instructions of the competent a uthority shall be followed. 4. DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED WITH THE TENDER 1. Identity proof of the contractor/proprietor. 2. PAN card. 3. Business registration / contractor registration certificate, wherever applicable. 4. GST registration certificate, if applicable. 5. Proof of office or service facility in Solapur District. 6. Details of relevant experience in RO water purifier installation/service, if available.

7. Duly signed Site Inspection Report (Annexure A). 8. Item-wise quotation showing equipment, materials, installation and other charges.
